reason: Steel could provide a frame to support the cabin mattress in the sheltered alcove.
expectation: The steel and mattress will make a supported berth.

alternatives.reason: The insulation might instead be used to make the mattress warmer.

effect: The mattress is now on a steel frame, but the open frame still needs insulation.
reaction: The raised berth is a satisfying start, and the remaining need is clear.
reason: The reflective insulation should fill the exposed insulating layer beneath the berth.
expectation: The insulation will complete the sheltered berth.

effect: The insulation completed the raised cave berth, and the chapter goal is finished.
reaction: The image of resting beside the still-empty growing room is a quiet, satisfying close.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the steel frame and raising the mattress made the berth feel like a practical use of the sheltered alcove.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the insulation was straightforward and less engaging as a decision, though it completed the berth sensibly.

surprise.text: The finished berth looked out toward an empty growing room, emphasizing that the shelter is ready before the growing work has begun.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the frame and insulation both had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see the empty growing room put to use; the practical construction and quiet ending left me curious.
